name: imagen-design-hub
description: MiriCanvas and DesignHub asset workflows for PNG elements, Aside/ChatGPT native transparent PNGs, JPG backgrounds, SVG/GIF beta routes, image-gen source creation, Photopea finishing, keyword cleanup, and PNG fringe QA.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare DesignHub PNG, ChatGPT transparent, JPG, SVG, GIF, and CSV assets.
interface.longDescription: Route MiriCanvas DesignHub work into focused flows for PNG elements, Aside/ChatGPT native transparent PNG batches, JPG backgrounds, SVG beta elements, GIF beta elements, and post-upload CSV metadata. The plugin defaults generation work to the installed $image-gen skill for chroma-key routes, uses Aside when the user wants logged-in ChatGPT native transparent output, reuses the copied chroma-key helper for PNG elements, adds magenta-fringe QA plus hidden-alpha QA on dark backgrounds, and always uses Computer Use for live DesignHub upload, CSV download, and merged CSV upload actions, including macOS file-picker steps.
defaultPrompt: Use $image-gen to prepare PNG elements for DesignHub.
Use aside-chatgpt-transparent when the user asks for Aside or ChatGPT native transparent PNG generation.
Run png-element chroma cleanup and fringe QA.
Always use Computer Use for live DesignHub file upload, CSV download, and merged CSV upload, including macOS file-picker steps.
